claim.notes: CFR+ (regret matching+, alternating updates, linear averaging), 5000 iterations, pure Python, game read from game.json. Exploitability and value were recomputed in exact rational arithmetic from the written strategy.json by a separate check script (check.py), with each infoset renormalized (worst sum error as written is 2e-16). Best-response values: p0 +0.529413290183, p1 -0.529411336213, so the game value lies in [0.5294113, 0.5294133], consistent with 9/17. Perfect recall verified. Infosets never reached by their owner's average strategy are written as uniform.
